_comment: Local fallback store for Notion Affiliate Agent — same schema as Notion databases, no API needed. Founder can review this file directly.

product_tracker.Name: Notion
product_tracker.Key Features: All-in-one workspace, databases, wikis, docs, project management
product_tracker.Commission Rate: Via Cuelinks — check dashboard after approval
product_tracker.Pros: Highly flexible, huge template ecosystem, strong free tier
product_tracker.Cons: Steep learning curve, can be slow with large databases

product_tracker.Name: Notion AI
product_tracker.Key Features: AI writing, summarization, Q&A over workspace, autofill
product_tracker.Cons: Add-on cost on top of Plus/Business, not as strong as ChatGPT for general tasks

product_tracker.Name: Notion Calendar
product_tracker.Key Features: Time-blocking, Google Calendar sync, Notion database integration
product_tracker.Pros: Excellent for time-blocking with Notion tasks, clean design
product_tracker.Cons: Requires Google Calendar, limited standalone calendar features vs Calendly

product_tracker.Name: Clio
product_tracker.Key Features: Client intake, matter management, time tracking, billing, trust accounting, integrations
product_tracker.Commission Rate: Via Cuelinks — check dashboard after approval (if listed)
product_tracker.Pros: Purpose-built for law firms, strong billing/trust accounting, large integrations marketplace
product_tracker.Cons: Higher cost at scale, less flexible than Notion for custom workflows, steeper setup for solo

product_tracker.Name: MyCase
product_tracker.Key Features: Case management, client portal, billing, calendar, task management
product_tracker.Commission Rate: Via Cuelinks — check dashboard after approval (if listed)
product_tracker.Pros: All-in-one for small firms, good client portal, integrated payments
product_tracker.Cons: Less customizable than Notion, per-user cost adds up, limited database flexibility
